result.headline: BMS under-voltage protection opened HV after SOC was re-stated by 33 points with no charge to explain it.
result.explanation: HV loss was the BMS protective response to cell under-voltage. Upstream, SOC estimation error, far-lower usable capacity, or under-read current all fit. Recorded data cannot separate them. No root cause confirmed.

evidence.quote: CHANGE battery.soc[bms] at t=1698.5 s: 45.2 -> 30.8 % (step -14.4, 9x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: The SOC estimate was abruptly re-stated while measured current stayed flat at 6.95 A. The full correction was 56.8 % to 24.0 % in 29 s, with 32.74 pp unexplained by measured charge.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT battery.pack_current held 6.95 from t=0 to 2100 s (4201 samples)
evidence.shows: Measured current was constant. Only about 4.1 Ah was delivered to the cutoff, against 60.4 Ah that the starting SOC promised.

evidence.quote: SHIFT battery.soc[bms] changed level for good at t=240 s: median 60.4 before, 58 after %
evidence.shows: Between corrections SOC tracked measured charge divided by capacity (ratio 1.036 and 1.291), so the estimator was coulomb counting with no visible voltage-based correction.

evidence.quote: SHIFT battery.cell_voltage[min] changed level for good at t=640 s: median 3.2 before, 2.864 after V (2240x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Cell voltage fell from t=640 s while SOC still read about 58 %. Voltage and SOC disagreed for roughly 1000 s before the correction.
Fault level 3 and both contactors opening at t=2100.5 s came after the earlier escalations (levels 1 and 2). This is the protective response.

checked.check: Charge accounting: SOC change against measured charge, per span
checked.result: SOC followed measured charge between corrections. The one step of 56.8 % to 24.0 % had 0.056 Ah measured against 32.74 pp unexplained.
SOC dropped from 57.2 to 23.6 % while pack current stayed 6.95 A with no change. Cell voltages moved only a few percent of a volt (max cell 2.967 to 2.941 V, min cell 2.779 to 2.743 V).

checked.check: Energy shortfall: charge delivered to cutoff against stated 100 Ah
checked.result: About 4.1 Ah delivered against 60.4 Ah promised. Needs SOC overstated by about 56 pp, or usable capacity about 7 Ah, or current under-measured about 14.9x.
checked.about: SOC estimation, capacity and current-sensing candidates

checked.check: Weak cell test: lowest cell against highest cell
checked.result: The highest cell also fell 450 mV, more than the 260 mV spread at the trip. The pack was depleted as a whole.

checked.check: Sensing and sequence checks: smoothness, rest rebound, order of events
checked.result: Lowest-cell samples never differed by more than 1 mV. Cells rebounded at rest (to 2.28 to 2.59 V). Contactors opened 0.0 s after fault level 3.
checked.about: Cell-voltage sensing fault; contactor or VCU event first

checked.result: No earlier cases in the workspace.

effects.why: Protective escalation to level 3 after under-voltage. It explains how HV was lost, not why the cells were that low.
Contactor opening at the same instant as fault level 3. It is the consequence of the protection.

effects.quote: CHANGE battery.pack_current at t=2094.5 s: 6.95 -> 0 A (step -6.95, 1000x its usual variation)
effects.why: Current went to zero about 6 s before the contactors opened. The recording does not show who or what commanded it; it is not evidence of cause.

next_action.action: Run a controlled capacity discharge logging an independent clamp current beside BMS current.
next_action.why: Separates under-read current, low usable capacity and stale SOC by comparing independent amp-hours to cutoff against BMS counts and the 100 Ah parameter.
how: Fully charge the pack and rest it, then log every cell's rest voltage.
Discharge at about 7 A with a calibrated clamp meter on the pack lead, plus the BMS current, SOC and all cell voltages.
Integrate the clamp Ah to the same cell cutoff and note when SOC jumps.
List standstill loads that tap the pack upstream of the BMS current sensor.
next_action.conditions: Pack fully charged and rested, ambient temperature the same as the incident, constant discharge about 7 A to the same cell cutoff.
next_action.baseline: This recording: BMS current 6.95 A, about 4.1 Ah delivered to cutoff, SOC step at 1698.5 s.

outcomes.label: Clamp current far above BMS reading
outcomes.means: The BMS under-reads current, or load bypasses its sensor. That explains the energy shortfall.
outcomes.then: Calibrate the current sensor and list upstream loads.

outcomes.label: Clamp matches BMS; Ah to cutoff near 7
outcomes.means: Usable capacity is far below the 100 Ah parameter. Check the parameter's origin and test cells.
outcomes.then: Request pack build record and per-cell capacity test.

outcomes.label: Clamp matches BMS; Ah to cutoff near 100
outcomes.means: The pack is healthy; the SOC estimate was stale or miscalibrated. Review SOC correction logic.
outcomes.then: Request SOC algorithm and calibration history.

unknowns: Which of SOC estimation error, usable capacity or current under-read caused the shortfall; the data cannot separate them.
Why SOC was re-stated at t=1681.5 s and what triggered the correction; the algorithm is not in the data.
Who or what drove the pack current to 0 A at t=1840 s and t=2094.5 s.
